1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device __extracts document actions from the documented procedure and compares temporal sequences of the extracted document actions with temporal sequences of the demonstrated user actions__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by determining which step in the temporal sequence of document actions most closely matches the temporal sequence of demonstrated user actions performed to date__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __in real-time as the demonstrated user actions are being performed__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification __with visual emphasis that dynamically updates as new demonstrated user actions are detected__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting which step should be performed next based on the alignment of completed demonstrated user actions with the document actions__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __in advance of the user performing that step__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification __to guide the user toward the predicted next action__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on __a comparison of semantic meaning and functional equivalence between actions in the user interface and the documented procedure, beyond common strings alone__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment __by analyzing hand gestures, tool usage, or physical object manipulation visible in the captured images__.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by learning from historical patterns of how users have previously deviated from or followed the documented procedure__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __and organizing them into a structured sequence with defined dependencies between steps__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __by analyzing temporal and functional relationships between actions__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment __by extracting action features from the images that are compared against action features in the documented procedure__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by applying machine learning models trained on historical user performance data__.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that measures correspondence between temporal sequences of actions__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by determining the step in the documented procedure that corresponds to the most recently completed demonstrated user action__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __such that the highlighting updates continuously as additional demonstrated user actions are detected__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by projecting forward from the current alignment position to determine the subsequent step the user should perform__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __to provide advance guidance to the user__.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on __functional equivalence and semantic correspondence between user interface actions and documented procedure actions, rather than string matching alone__.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __by extracting action primitives or motion patterns from the images__.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by incorporating statistical models of user behavior derived from prior executions__.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure __and establishing logical and temporal relationships among the extracted steps__.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, __wherein the program instructions implement alignment computation through analysis of temporal and functional correspondence between action sequences__.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that evaluates correspondence between temporal sequences of actions__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __by detecting and analyzing action features or motion patterns in the images__.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by applying learned models of user behavior patterns__.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, __wherein the program instructions implement alignment computation through temporal and functional analysis of action sequences__.
